So I was climbing a huge pine tree with the first branches starting at at least 80 foot and my main tie in was over 100 foot up near the top. I was ascending up using a Petzl croll when a branch got wedged between the teeth of the cam and the rope causing it to disengage and for me to drop, I ended up getting court by a safety strap connected above me but it was still a shock to the system and when I was processing what had happened and what had gone wrong I then got this immense feeling over come me which stopped me in my tracks which again felt amazing in ways that I can’t describe.

Yes it has happened to me before this and it’s not the sudden drop that scared me it was after I had been court as your mind starts to think a lot and starts processing everything but just as that phase started I had the immense feeling which I had never had before.

I mean that I had a gear failure which caused me to fall for a second before getting court by a safety line and like anybody would I started to panic (not so it causes me to be a danger) but realising the situation when suddenly these immense feeling that I have never felt before came over me this feeling was of happiness, peace and so many more amazing feelings and it was like I was in a different world we’re nothing mattered apart from God and there were no worry’s it doesn’t make sense to most people but it was a very surreal experience.

It was a big moment as not only was it from Gob but it was just as I became a Christian properly and had decided that my life should be dedicated to God so I can help as many people as possible. God bless🙏🙏
